description: Remote tech and other remote jobs from RemoteOK's public JSON feed: title, company, location, tags, salary range when given, apply link. Feed is refreshed frequently; RemoteOK asks API users to link back to remoteok.com. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_djinni when you need tech job postings from Djinni.co's public job list, read; jobs_jobspresso when you need newest remote jobs from Jobspresso's public job feed. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
